intro.title: Swami Atmanand Government English Medium School
intro.text:
The Swami Atmanand Utkrisht Vidyalaya Yojana was launched by the Government of Chhattisgarh on Rajyotsava, 1st November 2020, to give children from every background — especially from rural and economically weaker families — access to high-quality English-medium education, completely free of cost.

Our school in Sonhat brings this vision to the children of Sonhat block and nearby villages. With smart classrooms, science and computer laboratories, a library, sports facilities and dedicated teachers, we prepare our students to compete confidently at the state and national level while staying rooted in our culture and values.

principal.name: Dr. Ravi Kant Mishra
principal.quote: A little progress every day adds up to big results.
principal.message:
Dear students and parents, welcome to Swami Atmanand Government English Medium School, Sonhat. Our aim is to provide every child with quality education rooted in strong values, so that they grow into confident, responsible and compassionate citizens.

We believe each child is unique. Our teachers work to understand the needs of every student and help them discover their potential — in academics, sports, arts and life skills.

I thank our parents, the School Management Committee and the district administration for their continued support, and I invite everyone to join hands in building a bright future for our children.

about.text:
Swami Atmanand Government English Medium School, Sonhat is part of the Swami Atmanand Utkrisht Vidyalaya Yojana of the Government of Chhattisgarh. The scheme was launched on 1st November 2020, Chhattisgarh Rajyotsava, so that children from every section of society — especially from rural, tribal and economically weaker families — can receive high-quality English-medium education free of cost.

Located in Sonhat block of Koriya district, the school serves students from Class 1 to Class 12 and offers modern facilities including smart classrooms, science and computer laboratories, a library and sports grounds.
about.vision: To be a centre of excellence that nurtures every child into a confident, capable and compassionate citizen, equipped with knowledge, skills and values for the 21st century.
about.mission:
Provide a creative, skill-based learning environment in English medium.
Develop scientific temperament, curiosity and critical thinking.
Build self-motivation, discipline and a sense of responsibility.
Instil respect for our culture, environment and community.
Ensure equal opportunity for every child, regardless of background.
about.atmanand: Swami Atmanand (1929–1989) was a revered monk of the Ramakrishna Mission from Chhattisgarh, known for his work in education and the upliftment of tribal communities, particularly through the Ramakrishna Mission Ashram at Narayanpur. The Government of Chhattisgarh named this scheme of excellent schools in his memory to carry forward his ideals of service through education.

pta.text: The Parent Teacher Association (PTA) brings parents and teachers together to support each child's progress. Parent–Teacher Meetings are held regularly after each examination, and parents are always welcome to meet class teachers during school hours with prior information.

admission.note: Admission is as per the guidelines issued by the School Education Department, Government of Chhattisgarh and the District Administration, Koriya. Education is free of cost. Please follow the official notice for exact dates.
admission.eligibility:
Class 1: Child should be of the age prescribed by the State Government as on the cut-off date.
Classes 2–12: On the basis of vacant seats and previous class pass certificate.
Class 11: Stream allotment as per Class 10 results and seat availability.
admission.documents:
Birth certificate

Transfer Certificate & previous mark sheet (Class 2 onward)

admissionSteps.title: Collect Form
admissionSteps.text: Admission forms are available free of cost at the school office or as notified by the district.

admissionSteps.title: Submit Form
admissionSteps.text: Submit the filled form with required documents within the notified dates.

admissionSteps.title: Selection
admissionSteps.text: Where applications exceed seats, selection is done by lottery as per Government guidelines.

admissionSteps.title: Confirmation
admissionSteps.text: Selected students complete document verification and confirm admission.

classrooms.text: Spacious, well-lit classrooms equipped with smart boards and projectors. Teachers use digital content, animations and videos to make concepts clear and learning enjoyable.

labs.title: Physics Lab
labs.text: Apparatus for experiments in mechanics, optics, electricity and magnetism.

labs.title: Chemistry Lab
labs.text: Safe, well-ventilated lab with chemicals and glassware for practicals.

labs.title: Biology Lab
labs.text: Microscopes, specimens and models for life-science studies.

labs.title: Computer Lab
labs.text: Networked computers with internet for ICT and coding classes.

labs.title: English Language Lab
labs.text: Audio-visual tools to improve listening and speaking skills.

labs.title: Robotics / ATL Lab
labs.text: Kits for robotics, electronics and innovation projects.

library.text: Our library has textbooks, reference books, fiction, magazines and newspapers in English and Hindi. A reading period is part of the timetable to build a habit of reading in every student.

campus.title: Playground
campus.text: Open ground for football, kho-kho, kabaddi, athletics and morning assembly.

campus.title: Drinking Water
campus.text: RO purified drinking water and clean, separate toilets for boys and girls.

campus.title: Assembly Hall
campus.text: Space for cultural programmes, functions and meetings.

campus.title: Safety
campus.text: CCTV surveillance, fire extinguishers and a boundary wall for student safety.

activities.title: 🏃 Sports Events
activities.text: Students take part in athletics, football, volleyball, kho-kho, kabaddi, chess and yoga. The Annual Sports Meet and inter-house competitions help discover and nurture sporting talent, and students represent the school at block, district and state level.

activities.title: 🎭 Cultural Events
activities.text: Independence Day, Republic Day, Rajyotsava, Annual Function and festivals are celebrated with songs, dance (including Chhattisgarhi folk forms like Karma and Suwa), drama and art competitions.

activities.title: 💡 Technical Events
activities.text: Science exhibitions, quiz competitions, coding activities, robotics workshops and the INSPIRE-MANAK programme encourage innovation and scientific thinking.

activities.title: ⚜️ Scout Guide / NSS
activities.text: Through Bharat Scouts & Guides and NSS, students learn discipline, first aid, teamwork and community service — including cleanliness drives, plantation and awareness rallies.
